name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-20, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
